notes: Machine-readable index of every dataset in this mod. Adds wood as a new raw resource, four plant-derived items (charcoal, fruits, resin, wood ash), and the Arboretum 5 m production block. Three cross-mod hooks: charcoal → Coal Power's Combustion Generator, wood ash → Stone & Concrete's Cement, and placeholder hooks for fruits → future Food mod and resin → future Plastics mod. Arboretum is gameStatus 'planned' pending VS3 water.

datasets.description: Wood — new biogenic raw resource harvestable from forested planetary biomes.
Charcoal (refined fuel), fruits (Food-mod hook), resin (Plastics-mod hook), and wood ash (Cement hook).
Arboretum 5 m — greenhouse production block that renewably grows wood, fruits, and resin. Requires power and water (VS3-gated).
